owner_statement: very good - accepted. This is our reference gait model henceforth
timing_policy: Accepted art timing; use as the reference. Future authored cadence/proportion adaptations must preserve the phase sequence and anatomical constraints. These are not clinical measurements.
phase_sequence: heel contact and loading with brief double support
planted stance while the body passes over the support foot
backward knee flexion with lifted trailing foot
knee advances past the support knee before the swing foot passes
knee extension and foot advance into the next heel contact
constraints: thighs pivot at the painted anatomical pelvis centre
fixed anatomical left/right ownership throughout crossing and occlusion
knees straighten or flex backward only; no forward bend or hyperextension
fixed thigh/shin lengths within the authored cycle
grounded support soles and lifted swing foot
both knees and feet exchange leading/trailing roles each half-cycle
heel-to-toe contact roll and brief bilateral support handovers
scope_policy: Reference model for future walking animation work; preserve this accepted set. Does not initiate other-family revisions or Main integration.
